name: Roseburg Forest Products
description: Roseburg Forest Products, a privately owned company founded in 1936, manufactures diverse wood products like lumber, plywood, and engineered wood for North American construction and furniture markets. Operating numerous facilities across the U.S., it also manages extensive timberlands, though its California veneer plant in Weed recently closed.

name: Land O'Lakes Industrial Cheese
description: Land O'Lakes is a farmer-owned cooperative, established in 1921, that produces a variety of dairy products including butter, cheese, eggs, and whipping cream. They serve consumers by offering products and recipes, emphasizing their farmer-owners and the quality of their dairy items.

name: Saputo Cheese USA
description: Saputo Cheese USA transforms milk into high-quality, safe, and nutritious cheese and dairy products, serving consumers across the U.S. They offer a vast array of award-winning products and well-known brands, including mozzarella, provolone, blue cheese, cheddar, Monterey Jack, goat, hard Italian cheeses, feta, string, snacking, and ricotta.

name: Sun Pacific
description: Sun Pacific is a California-based agricultural company that grows, packs, and ships fresh produce, including Cuties® mandarins, Mighties® kiwi, oranges, Air Chief® grapes, and lemons. They serve consumers by providing a variety of fruits, focusing on quality from farm to table.

name: Monrovia Nursery
description: Monrovia Nursery grows and sells a wide variety of plants, including shrubs, perennials, trees, and edibles. Serving both home gardeners and landscape professionals, the company offers distinctive selections and resources, operating for over 100 years with a focus on developing strong root systems.

name: Winco Foods

name: Tulare Local Healthcare District
description: The Tulare Local Healthcare District manages and utilizes District resources to address the health needs of its population. It provides governance, oversight, and stewardship of healthcare assets and capital projects, supporting community wellness and public accountability, including the construction of the Tulare Tower.

description: The Tulare Joint Union High School District operates three comprehensive high schools, one continuation high school, one community day school, two charter high schools, and an adult school in Tulare, CA. It focuses on fostering student success and preparing students for future possibilities, with a high graduation rate and strong academic progress.

description: Porterville College is an educational institution that provides academic and career pathways in fields like Business, Health, Arts, and Public Safety. It serves new students, athletes, international students, high school students, and military veterans, offering support services such as counseling, health & wellness, and tutoring.

They provide comprehensive healthcare services for patients from birth through adulthood at their main and surrounding locations, including quick care and various specialty clinics.

With over 200 locations and hundreds of doctors, they serve a wide range of patients with advanced technology and diverse medical expertise.

With 52 locations, it serves the community by providing comprehensive medical care and promoting healthiness.

name: Porterville Developmental Center
description: Porterville Developmental Center is California's only state-operated facility serving individuals with mild to moderate intellectual disabilities who have legal system contact, are a danger to themselves or others, or are incompetent to stand trial. It provides personalized support, treatment, and training programs, including healthcare, education, and independent living skills, to maximize independence.

name: Sierra View Medical Center
description: Sierra View Medical Center is a 167-bed, full-service acute care facility in Porterville, California, serving the Southern Sequoia region of Tulare County. It provides comprehensive healthcare services, including an Advanced Primary Stroke Center, cancer treatment, and a Urology Clinic in alliance with Keck Medicine of USC.

name: Tulare County Office of Education

Key activities involve instructional support, professional learning, and operating various educational sites and student events.

name: Foster Farms
description: Foster Farms is a West Coast poultry producer offering premium chicken and turkey products, ranging from fresh whole chickens to ready-to-eat meals like wings and nuggets. They serve consumers and food service operations, focusing on responsibly raised poultry with no added hormones or steroids.

description: Woolf Farming and Processing operates in California's Central Valley, sustainably growing, processing, and delivering healthy natural products to the food chain. As a certified B Corp, they adhere to high standards of social commitment and environmental performance.

description: Clark Bros. Inc. and CBI Power, Inc. are full-service EPC contractors specializing in heavy civil and high-voltage electrical infrastructure across the western United States. They deliver turnkey solutions for complex projects in water, power, and renewables sectors, including wind, solar, hydro, and battery energy storage systems, serving developers and owners.

name: Fresno Plumbing and Heating
description: Fresno Plumbing and Heating Inc. has provided plumbing services in California's Central Valley since 1945, serving residential and commercial clients, including housing developments, schools, and medical facilities. They offer new construction, service, leak detection, re-piping, water heater services, sewer inspection, and backflow testing, supported by over 260 employees.

name: Anlin Industries
description: Anlin Windows & Doors is a top replacement window and door manufacturer based in Clovis, CA, serving homeowners with energy-efficient vinyl products. They offer a range of windows and patio doors, including options with in-glass pet doors, backed by a Limited Double Lifetime Warranty and 5-star customer service.

description: Lion Raisins, a five-generation family business since 1903, cultivates and supplies premium raisins and raisin-based products, including Golden and Dried-On-the-Vine varieties. They offer industrial solutions, distribution, and packaging services to customers worldwide, utilizing a state-of-the-art facility in California.

name: Cargill

description: Harris Ranch Beef Company is a beef producer that pioneered a branded beef program in 1982, serving retail, e-commerce, export, and foodservice customers. description: Lyons Magnus is a leader in the foodservice industry, developing and marketing high-quality products with innovative packaging since 1852. description: Central Valley Meat is a family-owned and operated company dedicated to providing high-quality, safe meat products. They prioritize continuous improvement, best-in-class food safety, and humane livestock handling, serving customers with BRC Certified products. description: The Coachella Valley Water District provides domestic water service and manages water resources for the Coachella Valley. It undertakes infrastructure projects like pipeline construction, ensures water quality, and offers customer assistance programs. The District collaborates with other local water agencies and the Agua Caliente Band of Cahuilla Indians.

description: Pacific Hydrotech Corporation is an experienced water engineering professional firm serving municipal water districts and oil refining companies across California, Hawaii, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Alaska, and Washington since 1987. They specialize in concrete tanks, pumping projects, and water/wastewater infrastructure.

name: Fortuna Rehabilitation and Wellness
description: Fortuna Rehabilitation & Wellness Center provides short-term and long-term rehabilitative and nursing care in Eureka, CA. Services include physical and speech therapy, 24-hour nursing, respite care, and hospice support, serving patients needing comprehensive wellness and recovery programs.

name: Granada Rehabilitation and Wellness
description: Granada Rehabilitation and Wellness Center offers high-quality nursing and rehabilitative care in Eureka, CA. They provide services including rehabilitation therapy, long-term care, respite care, hospice, and short-term care, educating patients on their condition and re-injury prevention.

name: Suddenlink
description: Suddenlink, a former Altice USA subsidiary, provided cable television, high-speed internet, and phone services to residential and business customers across 13 states, including California. It has since rebranded and is now fully integrated into Optimum, a larger connectivity provider.

name: Pierson Building Center
description: Pierson Building Center is Humboldt County's home center, providing building materials, lumber, garden supplies, and cabinets. Serving customers in Eureka, CA, it operates a main store with various departments, a garden shop, and a lumber yard.

name: Healthsport
description: HealthSPORT operates fitness clubs in Arcata, Eureka, McKinleyville, and Fortuna, offering a range of services including group fitness classes, personal training, swim lessons, gymnastics, and youth camps. It serves individuals of all ages and stages, aiming to empower health and wellness within the Humboldt community.

name: Red Lion Hotel Eureka
description: Red Lion Hotel Eureka, part of Sonesta International Hotels Corporation, provides hospitality services. It offers accommodations for business and leisure travelers, with a wide range of experiences across its over 1,100 hotels in the U.S. and beyond, including meetings and events.

name: Calpine
description: Calpine is America's premier competitive power company, generating approximately 27,000 megawatts of clean and reliable electricity from 78 facilities across North America. It serves about 27 million homes and businesses, offering retail energy solutions and developing carbon capture technologies for a clean energy future.

name: Scully Packing
description: Scully Packing Company LLC is a California-based organization specializing in packing and selling premium pears. They operate a packinghouse and cold storage facilities, serving customers seeking California's best pears. Key activities include food safety, sustainability, and managing sales for various pear varieties.

name: Adventist Health Clear Lake
description: Adventist Health Clear Lake provides comprehensive healthcare services, including emergency, heart and vascular, primary care, and surgery, to the community. With over 1,400 caregivers, the organization focuses on high-quality, personalized, whole-person care for patients and families.

name: Rancheria Grille
description: Robinson Rancheria Resort & Casino, located on the north shore of Clear Lake, operates a large casino with slots, table games, and a 900-seat bingo facility. It also features dining options like The Grill, a hotel, and entertainment, serving guests in the Far North region of California.

name: Forestry and Fire Protection
description: The California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) safeguards California's people, property, and over 31 million acres of wildlands. It provides fire protection, all-hazard emergency response, and forest stewardship, including prevention, vegetation management, and reforestation, serving communities statewide, including the Far North region.

name: Northeastern Rural Health
description: Northeastern Rural Health Clinics provides comprehensive medical, dental, and behavioral health services, including urgent care and primary care, to Lassen County. As the largest outpatient care provider in the region, it serves over 50,000 patients annually, accepting various insurance plans and offering sliding fee discounts.

name: Banner Lassen Medical Center
description: Banner Lassen Medical Center, a 25-bed critical access hospital in Susanville, California, provides outstanding clinical care and patient experience. It offers a wide range of programs and services including emergency, imaging, maternity, and surgery, focusing on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of illness.

name: Caito Fisheries
description: Caito Fisheries is a wholesale seafood dealer operating across California, with locations in Fort Bragg, San Francisco, Crescent City, Half Moon Bay, and Eureka. They specialize in seafood products, including Dungeness Crab, serving businesses in the region.

name: Constellation Brands
description: Constellation Brands is a multinational producer and marketer of beer, wine, and spirits.

name: Fetzer Vineyards
description: Fetzer Vineyards produces a variety of wines, including Gewürztraminer, Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon, Pinot Grigio, Riesling, Merlot, and Sauvignon Blanc. As a Certified B Corp, the company is committed to sustainable practices, caring for its workers, communities, and the environment. They serve consumers seeking good wines for various occasions.

name: Mendocino Community Health
description: Mendocino Community Health is a healthcare organization providing services to the community.

name: Adventist Health Mendocino
description: Adventist Health Mendocino Coast provides award-winning healthcare services, including primary care, emergency care, cancer care, and surgery, to Fort Bragg and surrounding communities. Their team of caregivers focuses on quality and patient experience, offering personalized, whole-person services to inspire health and wholeness.

name: Pacific Medical Resources
description: Eternal Medical Resources and Eternal Homecare Solutions provides home health care services, serving the elderly, veterans, disabled, and vulnerable members of the community across Mendocino, Lake, Humboldt, Del Norte, and Sonoma counties in California. They offer personalized care plans, 24/7 RN support, and advanced technology for monitoring and management.

name: Adventist Health Ukiah Valley
description: Adventist Health Ukiah Valley is a faith-based healthcare provider serving Mendocino County, California. It offers a wide range of services including emergency care, cancer care, heart and vascular care, maternity, orthopedics, and primary care, aiming to inspire health, wholeness, and hope in the community.

name: Thurston Toyota
description: Thurston Toyota is a new and used car dealership in Ukiah, CA, serving areas like Willits, Fort Bragg, Lakeport, and Kelseyville. They offer sales of Toyota vehicles, financing options, and comprehensive car service and repair, including parts, to individual customers.

name: Ukiah City Civic Center
description: The City of Ukiah Civic Center provides municipal services including utility services, parks and recreation, public safety, and infrastructure improvements. It serves residents and businesses in Ukiah, California, focusing on sustainable practices, economic development, and community well-being.

name: Heritage House Resort & Spa
description: The Heritage House Resort & Spa is a cliffside retreat on the Mendocino coast, offering accommodations, dining with ocean views, a spa, and venues for weddings and events. It serves guests seeking luxury and relaxation in Northern California.

name: Little River Inn
description: Little River Inn is a family-owned hospitality business operating for over 80 years on the Mendocino Coast of California. It offers over sixty rooms with ocean views, dining options including a restaurant and bar, an Audubon-certified golf course, and event spaces for weddings and corporate events.

name: US Forest Service - Modoc National Forest
description: Modoc National Forest, located in California's northeastern corner, is a U.S. government organization managing diverse landscapes including volcanic Cascades, Warner Mountains, and the Devil's Garden Wild Horse Territory. It serves the public by offering recreational opportunities like hiking, fishing, and OHV use, managing natural resources, and overseeing wild horse adoption programs.

name: Seneca Healthcare District
description: Seneca Healthcare District is a Critical Access Hospital and Rural Health Clinic serving the Lake Almanor area of California. It provides comprehensive inpatient and outpatient care, including a 10-bed acute hospital, 24/7 emergency services, a 16-bed skilled nursing facility, and a walk-in clinic with diagnostic imaging, surgical, and therapy services.

name: Shasta County Mental Health Services
description: Shasta County Mental Health Services, part of the Health and Human Services Agency, provides comprehensive mental health, crisis, and substance use recovery services to adults, children, and families across Shasta County. Key activities include outpatient counseling, medication support, case management, and 24-hour crisis response.

name: Vibra Hospital of Northern California
description: Vibra Hospital of Northern California, part of Vibra Healthcare, provides critical care, medical rehabilitation, and skilled nursing services in Redding, CA. It serves patients recovering from serious injuries, illnesses, and debilitating medical conditions, offering personalized treatment plans and compassionate care.

name: Mayers Memorial Hospital Burney
description: Mayers Memorial Healthcare District provides comprehensive, patient-focused healthcare services, including acute care, emergency services, outpatient care, skilled nursing, and telemedicine. They serve the Intermountain Community in Fall River Mills, CA, focusing on quality and compassionate care.

name: Mayers Memorial Hospital District
description: Mayers Memorial Healthcare District provides comprehensive, patient-focused healthcare services, including acute care, emergency, surgical, and outpatient services. It serves the Intermountain Community in the Far North region of California, offering quality and compassionate care to its residents.

name: Klamath National Forest
description: The Klamath National Forest and Butte Valley National Grassland manage 1.7 million acres in Northern California and Southern Oregon, offering diverse recreation like camping, hiking, and wildlife watching. They focus on forest health, fire prevention, and natural resource management, serving the public and local communities.

name: Siskiyou County Public Works
description: Siskiyou County Public Works constructs and maintains 1,361 miles of roadways and 175 bridges in unincorporated Siskiyou County. They also manage the County's fleet system and provide engineering and surveying services, serving the residents and infrastructure needs of the county.

name: Mount Shasta Resort
description: Mount Shasta Resort is an all-season resort in Far Northern California, offering lodging in private forest chalets, an 18-hole golf course, and exceptional dining at Highland House Restaurant. It serves guests seeking outdoor recreation, leisure, and event hosting, providing amenities like a day spa and a family-friendly lounge.

name: Crain Walnut Shelling
description: Crain Walnut Shelling, LP is one of California's largest family-owned producers, packers, and processors of quality English Walnuts. They serve industrial ingredient and export markets in the U.S. and internationally, supported by marketing agreements with over 500 growers.

name: Bell-Carter Foods
description: Bell-Carter Foods, founded in 1912, is one of the world's largest table olive producers, employing nearly 300 people. They provide innovative olive products and services to retailers and foodservice organizations, focusing on quality and customer success.

name: St Elizabeth Community Hospital
description: Dignity Health is a nonprofit healthcare organization operating over 40 hospitals and 400 care centers across California, Arizona, and Nevada. It provides high-quality, affordable healthcare services, including urgent, occupational, imaging, home health, and primary care, serving millions with a patient-centered approach.

name: Tehama County Health Services Agency
description: Tehama County Health Services Agency is an integrated agency addressing the health and human service needs of Tehama County residents. It offers behavioral health, primary medical, public health, and substance use recovery services, serving all age groups from children to seniors through education, prevention, assessment, and treatment.

name: Corning Ford
description: Corning Ford is a Ford dealership in Corning, CA, serving drivers across the Bay Area, Sacramento, San Jose, Napa, Tehama County, Red Bluff, and Chico, CA. They sell new and pre-owned Ford vehicles, including trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, and offer auto financing, parts, and maintenance services.

name: Sierra Pacific Windows
description: A manufacturer of windows and doors.

name: Rolling Hills Casino RV Park
description: Rolling Hills Casino and Resort is a hospitality and entertainment destination in Corning, California, offering a casino with slots and table games, hotels, an RV park, diverse dining, an equestrian center, and a golf course. It serves travelers and visitors seeking gaming, lodging, and recreation.

name: USDA Forest Service
description: The USDA Forest Service manages national forests and grasslands, focusing on land management, fire management, and natural resource conservation. It serves the public through recreation opportunities and works with partners on initiatives like shared stewardship, addressing issues such as wildfire risk and water protection across the U.S.

name: Trinity River Lumber
description: Trinity River Lumber Company, a full-scale softwood mill in Weaverville, California, has been locally owned and operated since 1983. It specializes in producing 2" and 4" wane-free home center products, including Douglas Fir and Hem Fir, in lengths 8' to 20', primarily serving the California housing market.
